summary: The coins-arc-to-the-wallet reward effect, pooled and capped so a big reward stays cheap.
overview: The classic mobile reward feedback: icons arc from a pickup toward a UI target and vanish. It answers the obvious performance question up front in two ways — icons come from the existing object pool rather than Instantiate and Destroy, and a burst is capped so awarding a thousand coins does not spawn a thousand icons.
useCases: Coins or gems flying to the wallet on pickup.
XP orbs arcing to a level bar.
Any reward that should feel collected rather than just counted.

params.tuning: The cap that keeps a large reward affordable. Players read a dozen icons as "lots" just as well as a hundred.
Zero launches them all at once, which reads as one blob rather than a stream.
Zero is a straight line and looks mechanical. The arc is most of the effect.

gotchas.title: Visual count is not the reward amount
gotchas.body: The cap means icons are decorative. Award the real value separately — never count the icons.
